sections.heading: New Features
items: Ad & pop-up blocker — Settings → Ads & pop-ups, plus a per-site switch in the 3-dot menu
Save pages for offline reading — new Save page dialog, a Saved pages screen in the Wind menu, and an Offline badge in the address bar
Toolbar and bottom menu hide while you scroll down and come back when you scroll up
Landscape mode redesigned — one bottom bar (back, forward, address bar, tabs, new tab, menu) with new Home and Tab Switcher layouts
Rearranging Home shortcuts is now smooth, Edge style — the other icons slide out of the way
Site dark theme is closer to Chrome — softer dark background, and images and icons keep their real colors
Redesigned Ask before downloading and Change wallpaper daily switches — the whole row is tappable

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Open tabs no longer disappear after the browser was in the background
The browser no longer crashes in the background when the system frees memory — the page just reloads
Back on an ad or pop-up tab returns to the page that opened it, not Home
Home search bar text is readable on every wallpaper in light theme
Status bar and toolbar are plain white in light theme — no blue tint
New download icon in the 3-dot menu

sections.heading: New Features
items: Edit the file name before downloading — tap the pencil in the download dialog
Failed downloads can be retried with one tap — they resume from where they stopped
Tapping a download notification opens the Downloads page; new Resume and Retry buttons in download notifications
Inactive tabs now open in a full-screen page inside the Tab Switcher, with Close all (Chrome style)
Redesigned Shortcuts and Background switches in the Home menu — the whole row is tappable

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Back then Forward on the Home page no longer closes your other tabs one by one
Closed tabs are now fully released — no more wrong pages in other tabs or sound from a closed tab
Tab counters now count active tabs only
The selected tab is outlined in the Tab Switcher when Home is open
Downloading a file with the same name no longer overwrites the old one — it is saved as images-1.jpg, images-2.jpg…
Downloaded APK files now open in the package installer
Paused downloads resume instead of failing, and interrupted downloads no longer end up corrupted
Home screen shortcut confirmation now appears after you tap Add, not before

sections.heading: New Features
items: Inactive Tabs Management — set rules to move inactive tabs (Never / 7 / 14 / 21 days)
Automatically close inactive tabs option — auto-cleans tabs older than 3 months
In-app Update dialog — prompts to upgrade with built-in changelog viewer
Full Changelog history screen added under Settings → About
Smart link & image context menus (Chrome-style: copy link address, text, open incognito)
AI-generated wallpaper collection (Sky, Space, Gradient)

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: My Photos no longer show broken images after app restart
Daily wallpaper rotation now works reliably
Fixed back button navigation in Settings
Context menu no longer mixes up links and images

sections.heading: What's New
items: Full rebuild with Jetpack Compose
Dark / light theme switching without restart
Tab switcher redesign
Download system rebuilt in Compose
